name: freeze-v3

draft_status.state: draft for the freeze-v3 review; the supervisor approved robust fusion as the main RQ4 hypothesis and the guard settings on 2026-11-17; the remaining choices listed here await confirmation
draft_status.rule: this block is deleted before the tag; thesis.frozen_v3.validate(cfg, for_tag=True) refuses a file that still has it

scope: RQ4 (robust fusion, the run-time guard, the pre-deployment check, the stress statistic, H4r, H4a-H4e, the bound check, the drift slope) for the single IEEE-CIS run. freeze-v1 (frozen_config.json) and freeze-v2 (frozen_features_v2.json) are unchanged and apply in full; this file adds to them and overrides nothing. The freeze-v1 primary fusion (min-max + mean) and every freeze-v1 analysis are unchanged.
development_data: Developed on ULB: robust fusion (train-percentile + median), the bound check and the guard rule were developed on ULB day 1 -> day 2 (development data, docs/notes/robust_fusion_check_2026-11-17, results/tables/robust_fusion/, results/tables/e3_ulb/stress/); IEEE-CIS month 1 (days 0-20 -> 21-29) was used label-free. ULB results are reported as development data, not as a test

rq4.text: When one ensemble member breaks under temporal drift, can a label-free ensemble keep its false alarms under control through its choice of calibration and fusion, without detecting the break, and how does this compare with detecting and excluding the member (run-time guard)?
rq4.main_mechanism: robust fusion (tolerate the break): train-percentile calibration + median aggregation; approved by the supervisor on 2026-11-17
rq4.comparison: the run-time guard (detect and exclude, H4b, H4c); the pre-deployment check (H4a) is a secondary test

robust_fusion.calibration: train-percentile: share of the member's training scores <= s (fusion.Calibrator 'percentile')
robust_fusion.aggregation: median over the members (numpy.median; for even m the mean of the two middle values); fusion.EXTRA_AGGREGATIONS, outside the six freeze-v1 fusion configurations
robust_fusion.threshold: numpy.quantile(fused month-1 training scores, q, method 'linear'); alert if fused score > threshold
robust_fusion.seeds: IForest-containing ensembles fused once per seed, as in freeze-v1
robust_fusion.label: developed on ULB
robust_fusion.proposition: docs/writing/notes/robust_fusion_proposition.md: with b <= floor((m-1)/2) broken members an alert needs ceil(m/2) - b healthy members above the threshold, so the fused alert rate <= (sum of the healthy members' rates above the threshold) / (ceil(m/2) - b)

statistic.r: r_m = alerts of member m in a window / (rows in the window x (1 - q)); an alert is a score > the member's threshold
statistic.threshold: numpy.quantile(training scores of m, q, method 'linear'), one per IForest seed (freeze-v1 thresholds.common.rule)
statistic.q: 1 - budget, for every IEEE-CIS budget of freeze-v1 (0.005, 0.01, 0.02); the primary budget 0.02 gives q = 0.98
statistic.iforest: alerts summed over the five seeds and rows multiplied by five (= the seed mean of the alert rate)
statistic.ties: r = c passes. The comparison alerts <= c x (1 - q) x rows x seeds is made exactly on integers with fractions.Fraction (1 - q taken from the budget's decimal string), so a ratio that is exactly c is never moved by float rounding

guard.pass_rule: member passes on day d if r_m,d <= c
guard.window: one test day (freeze-v1 day rule); r_m,d from that day's own unlabelled scores at the frozen month-1 threshold
guard.fallback: if fewer than min_members members of an ensemble pass on a day, the static ensemble is used that day
guard.fusion: min-max + mean (freeze-v1 primary) of the kept members; calibrators fitted on each kept member's month-1 training scores; IForest seeds paired as in freeze-v1
guard.e_guard: E-guard(X) = ensemble X under the guard

pre_deployment.fitted_on_fit_days: freeze-v2 feature parameters, z-score, every detector (KNN/LOF fit sample of freeze-v1), thresholds
pre_deployment.rule: the guard rule (one-sided, absolute, c = 3, r = c passes, exact) applied to r on days 21-29 at the days 0-20 threshold
pre_deployment.e_stress: E-stress(X) = members of X that pass, fused with min-max + mean; static X if fewer than 2 pass
pre_deployment.use: reported for every ensemble and budget, descriptive; H4a uses its r; not used for H4b

evaluation.daily_budget: every RQ4 comparison uses a fixed daily budget: K_d = ceil(budget x n_d) on each test day d (freeze-v1 k rule per day), FP@K_d with the freeze-v1 tie rule; the statistic is the sum over all test days of months 2-6. The static comparator is evaluated the same way
evaluation.why_daily: the guard decides per day, so a guarded score is comparable within a day only
evaluation.freeze_v1_statistics: the freeze-v1 analyses (H1a, H1b, H2b, H3a, H3b, E4, context) run unchanged with their monthly K
evaluation.bootstrap: the freeze-v1 IEEE-CIS resamples (month-stratified day-block, 1000 resamples, numpy.random.default_rng(0), one stream, months 2-6 in order): in each resample a drawn day contributes its own FP@K_d; H4a recomputes every monthly alert rate from the drawn days
evaluation.seeds: IForest-containing methods: FP@K_d per seed, mean over the five seeds

H4r.question: RQ4, main hypothesis (developed on ULB)

i_threshold.statistic: D = mean over months 2-6 of |log r_month|, r_month = month alert rate at the frozen month-1 threshold of the method's fused training scores / (1 - q); IForest: alerts summed over the five seeds, rows multiplied by five; dD = D(method) - D(comparator)
i_threshold.zero_alert_month: a month with no alert (summed over seeds) counts as 0.5 alert
i_threshold.ci: evaluation.bootstrap: every month's alert rate recomputed from the drawn days
i_threshold.supported_if: the 95% day-block CI of dD lies entirely below 0

ii_budget.statistic: dFP = sum over test days of FP@K_d(method) - FP@K_d(comparator), budget 0.02, daily K
ii_budget.supported_if: the 95% day-block CI of dFP does not lie entirely above 0 (not worse; no margin)

H4r.supported_if: (i) and (ii) both hold; each part is reported with its own verdict
H4r.descriptive: E-bench and E-bench-5% under the same comparison (both parts); q = 0.99 for part (i); every budget for part (ii)

H4a.question: RQ4, pre-deployment prediction (secondary; a short negative result on ULB)
H4a.statistic: Spearman rho over members x months (6 singles x months 2-6 = 30 pairs) between x = |log r_m| from the pre-deployment check and y = |log r_m,month| (month alert rate at the frozen month-1 threshold / (1 - q)), q = 0.98
H4a.ranks: average ranks for ties; log 0 = +infinity ranks as the largest deviation
H4a.ci: evaluation.bootstrap, y recomputed in every resample, x fixed
H4a.supported_if: the 95% CI of rho lies entirely above 0

H4b.question: RQ4, detect and exclude
H4b.statistic: dFP = sum over test days of FP@K_d(method) - FP@K_d(comparator)
H4b.supported_if: the 95% CI of dFP lies entirely below 0
H4b.descriptive: E-guard(E-all) against robust E-all (train-percentile + median), daily K, every budget: the comparison of detect-and-exclude with tolerate

H4c.question: RQ4 b, no harm
H4c.supported_if: the 95% CI of dFP does not lie entirely above 0 (no harm shown; not a non-inferiority test with a margin)

H4d.status: exploratory, developed after seeing ULB, appendix only: reported as an association, no decision
H4d.statistic: Spearman rho over the six singles between the fragility index F_m (month-1 training scores, q = 0.98) and the mean over months 2-6 of log r_m,month (q = 0.98)
H4d.fragility: F_m = share of training scores > t - 0.1 (t - median), divided by (1 - q); t = the frozen threshold; IForest: mean of the five seeds; 0.1 is fixed and not tuned
H4d.decisions: none: no member is excluded on F

H4e.statistic: E-guard(E-bench), robust E-all and static E-bench against median_single and oracle_best_single (test labels, an upper bound), daily K, every budget

bound_check.statistic: per month and IForest seed, for each ensemble under train-percentile + median at q = 0.98: the fused alert rate, the rate of rows with at least ceil(m/2) - b healthy members above the threshold, and the bound (sum of the healthy members' rates above the threshold) / (ceil(m/2) - b); b = 0, and b = 1 with the broken member = the member with the largest month r at its own month-1 threshold (q = 0.98)

drift_slope.drift_share: Evidently DataDriftPreset (freeze-v1 hypotheses.H3b.drift_share), reference = month 1, current = each of months 2-6
drift_slope.deviation: |r_m,month - 1| at q = 0.98 (the freeze-v1 H3a deviation divided by the target)
drift_slope.statistic: per member, the least-squares slope of the deviation on the drift share over the five months

hypotheses.multiplicity: no correction (as freeze-v1): H4r part (i), H4a and H4b are one-sided 2.5% tests; H4r part (ii) and H4c are no-harm checks; H4r needs both of its parts

breaks: a member breaks if the guard (statistic, guard) excludes it from E-all on at least one test day at the primary budget
if_no_member_breaks: if no member breaks (breaks), then H4r part (i) becomes a no-harm check (supported if the 95% CI of dD does not lie entirely above 0) and part (ii) is unchanged; H4b is reported as 'not testable: no member broke' (E-guard equals the static ensemble, dFP = 0 by identity) and H4c as descriptive; H4a is decided as stated (it needs no break); H4d and H4e are descriptive in every case. The member-day table of r and the bound check are reported in every case

removed.relative_to_median: rules on r relative to the median member are not used: on ULB they removed KNN, the only member on target (results/tables/e3_ulb/stress/stress_deltas.csv), and in IEEE-CIS month 1 the median r was 0.039, so they flagged the members on target (results/tables/ieee_cis/stress_month1.csv)
removed.two_sided: the lower bound 1/c is not used: within-window undershoot came from the night hours on ULB and from a count-feature burst on days 8-13 of IEEE-CIS month 1, and on ULB the two-sided rules kept only KNN and added false alarms (results/tables/e3_ulb/stress/stress_deltas.csv)
removed.sead: SEAD (Shah et al. 2025) is cited as related work and not run as a baseline
removed.h4e_chosen_single: the best single chosen with month-1 labels is not used: H4e is descriptive and reads no month-1 label

runner.runs: once, after the freeze-v3 tag; freeze-v1 and freeze-v3 analyses together
